failures.question: 每个月的订单量环比增长率是多少？
failures.generatedSql:
WITH monthly_orders AS (
    SELECT DATE_TRUNC('month', order_purchase_timestamp) AS month,
           COUNT(*) AS order_count
    FROM orders
    GROUP BY 1
),
monthly_growth AS (
    SELECT month,
           order_count,
           LAG(order_count) OVER (ORDER BY month) AS prev_order_count
    FROM monthly_orders
)
SELECT month,
       ROUND((order_count - prev_order_count)::numeric / NULLIF(prev_order_count, 0), 4) AS mom_growth_rate
FROM monthly_growth
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 1000;
